mathematical_properties: For every symbolic full-width u64 tuple, local project_actor returns delivered_cursor, completed_cursor, recoverable_cursor, checkpoint_epoch, and configuration_revision equal to the corresponding fields of the actual production ActorObservation input.
For failed_cursor and checkpoint_unix_millis, local project_actor preserves Option discriminant and, when Some, the full symbolic u64 payload.
local project_create_response preserves CreateActorResponse.actor presence and, when present, its selected actor projection.
local project_update preserves UpdateActorRequest.expected_configuration_revision and UpdateActorResponse.actor presence plus the selected actual actor projection.
These are field-preservation theorems over actual generated production wire types; they do not assert equivalence to a production projection function.
